text: Politeness is a script. You already know your next three lines. So does everyone else. Say the fourth one instead.
Accepting what came before is not agreeing with it. It is refusing to pretend it did not happen. Conversations die of pretending.
The inner editor is not protecting you from saying something stupid. It is protecting you from saying something true. Those feel identical from the inside.
You cannot control how a sentence lands. You can only control whether it was yours. Aim for the second thing.
Interesting people are not the ones with better material. They are the ones who noticed what everyone else skipped. Notice the skipped thing.
You cannot rehearse your reply and hear the other person at the same time. Pick one. Everyone can tell which one you picked.
Your first reaction arrives before your reputation does. The polished version that follows is addressed to an audience that mostly is not there.
There is no wrong word in a conversation, only words you abandoned before anyone could meet them. Abandonment is the thing people actually notice.
In every exchange there is one detail that carries real information. It is rarely the one being discussed. It is the one both of you stepped around.
Small talk is not shallow because the topics are small. It is shallow because nobody is risking anything. A true sentence about the weather is not small talk.
You do not know what they are feeling. You are guessing. Guessing out loud — I imagine that stung — is intimacy. Guessing silently is just surveillance.
Things happen to you all day. A story is just an event you bothered to keep. People without stories are people who threw everything away.
Every yes you do not mean costs somebody something. Usually you. A clean no is more generous than a resentful yes, and everyone can taste the difference.
If they like the agreeable version of you, you have not been liked yet. That is the loneliness of good behaviour.
A conversation is not a test with hidden right answers. It is two people making something that did not exist an hour ago. You are allowed to enjoy that.
